observations: Photo 0 is a composite marketing or stock image, not a photo of a physical item in a home or shop.
The image shows a black portable fan with a wire safety cage.
The fan is mounted on a base designed for slide-on rechargeable battery packs.
A red power switch is visible on the fan base.
The image includes a standalone battery pack and a wall charger.
Text 'European standard' is visible in the bottom right of photo 0.
No brand name or model number is visible on the product in the image.

claims.evidence: A stock photo cannot verify the battery chemistry or the functional state of the actual item being sold.
The stock photo shows two batteries (one on the fan, one separate), but does not prove the seller possesses them.

risks.risk: The item may not match the stock photo or may not exist.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual item in a real-world setting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic non-functional unit

risks.risk: The lithium batteries may be degraded or dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on each battery for at least 10 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as batteries needing immediate replacement

risks.risk: The charger may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual charger and a video of it charging a battery.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual item you have for sale, not stock images.
A photo showing both batteries and the charger together.
A video of the fan operating on battery power.
A photo of the manufacturer's label or plate on the bottom of the fan or battery.
response.reason: The seller has provided only a stock marketing image. It is impossible to verify the condition, brand, or even the presence of the item and its accessories without real photos.
